import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    val = [-1 if x % 2 == 0 else 1 for x in arr]
    prefix_sum = 0
    cost = []
    for i in range(n - 1):
        prefix_sum += val[i]
        if prefix_sum == 0:
            diff = arr[i+1] - arr[i]
            cost.append(abs(diff))
    cost.sort()
    tcost = 0
    maxp = 0
    for c in cost:
        if tcost + c <= b:
            tcost += c
            maxp += 1
    print(maxp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
